items.q: Which platforms do you build on?
items.a: We choose the platform that fits your needs: Webflow, Shopify or composable architecture. We are official partners of Netlify, Webflow, Shopify and Sanity.

items.q: Who owns the code and the accounts?
items.a: You do. You keep 100% ownership of your code, design assets and accounts from day one.

items.q: Do I see the design before you build it?
items.a: Yes. Layout, content and behavior are drawn and agreed on paper first. You review drawings of every key page before we write code, so changes are cheap.
Design, development, CMS setup, technical SEO, accessibility checks and analytics, plus launch support. We stay on for the first weeks after launch and offer ongoing maintenance.

items.q: Do you handle SEO and AI search visibility?
items.a: Yes. Technical SEO, structured data, and AEO and GEO (optimization for answer engines and generative AI) are built in, so search engines and AI tools can read and cite your site accurately.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope and platform. Send a short brief through the form and we reply with a written quote within two working days.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on scope. Timelines are agreed during the Listen stage, before any design work starts.
